title: Selling Property to Foreign Buyers? Dub Your Video Tours
description: International buyers watch video tours before they ever visit. Dubbing your property walkthroughs into their language wins more of them.
excerpt: Foreign buyers decide from the video tour long before they fly in. A dubbed walkthrough in their language is what gets them on the plane.
content:
High-value property increasingly sells to buyers who are not in the country. They shortlist from video tours online, then fly in only for the places that already convinced them. If your walkthrough is in one language, you are invisible to everyone who does not speak it.

**Subtitles lose the sale**

A property tour is emotional — the light, the space, the agent's tone as they point out a view. Subtitles turn that into reading homework and drain the feeling that makes someone imagine living there.

**Dub the tour, win the buyer**

[TubeVoice](https://tubevoice.io) dubs your walkthrough into 50+ languages while keeping the agent's voice and pacing. A buyer in Germany or the Gulf hears the same warm tour in their own language and feels invited, not excluded.

**One listing, many markets**

Film the tour once. Dubbed into a few languages, that single video works on international portals, in email outreach, and in paid ads targeting foreign buyers — from one shoot. For premium and investment property, that reach pays for itself on a single deal.

**Where to start**

Take your best current listing and dub the tour into the two or three languages your foreign enquiries already come from. Put the localized version on the portals those buyers use. The agents who do this look global; the ones who do not stay local.

Buyers decide from the tour. Make sure yours speaks their language.
